content: The answer returned by one of our models was ‘alanine aminotransferase’, which is an enzyme. The model returns an enzyme, when the question asked for the organ name. To address this type of errors, we decided to try the concepts of ‘Lexical Answer Type’ (LAT) and Focus Word, which was used in IBM Watson, see BIBREF11 for overview; BIBREF10 for technical details, and BIBREF9 for details on question analysis.
